crossRefs.note: He waited yet another seven days; and again he sent the dove out of the ship.
Behold, you are beautiful, my love. Behold, you are beautiful. Your eyes are like doves.
For behold, the winter is past. The rain is over and gone.
The flowers appear on the earth. The time of the singing has come, and the voice of the turtledove is heard in our land.
My dove in the clefts of the rock, in the hiding places of the mountainside, let me see your face. let me hear your…
“Behold, I send you out as sheep among wolves. Therefore be wise as serpents, and harmless as doves.

translations.web: He himself sent out a dove to see if the waters were abated from the surface of the ground,
translations.bsb: Then Noah sent out a dove to see if the waters had receded from the surface of the ground.
translations.kjv: Also he sent forth a dove from him, to see if the waters were abated from off the face of the ground;
translations.asv: And he sent forth a dove from him, to see if the waters were abated from off the face of the ground;
